notes: Loop 3, German first (was 7.8). Read all 11 /try screens, try-report/try-rehearsal, the four demos, landing and src/report. Four of six loop-2 items are fixed, two partly. /try now asks the lunch spend (screen 6) and what the test costs, with 13,90 € as the dated fallback (screen 9). The placeholder run gives a break-even of 4 and a switching cost (try-report.txt:223, 263). The predict box hides every answer, and a low guess gets both missed costs in her own numbers (sections.ts:629-666). A /try owner can run the rule-based rehearsal (try-rehearsal.txt). A two-question self-check practises the rule, including sunk cost. The price demo teaches the minimum wage as a worked example (report-price.txt:204-216). The AI demo's 'Wer die Gäste spielt, verändert die Geschichte' is a strong AI-literacy contrast. What keeps it below 8.5: the middle scenario is still 'Erwartet' beside 'Ihre wahrscheinliche Schätzung'. The wage card concludes 'trägt die Lohnerhöhung also' on +1,40 € before employer contributions and never says the rise hits both options. 'Fakt' names both her till numbers and public rules, and the take-home question leaves public rules out. After a result, the closing lesson still says −118 €. /try sets the range and the switching share itself.
improvements: Price demo, wage card (src/engine/messages.de.ts:434-435 price.wage.plain.covers/short, the same keys in messages.ts/es/pl, and the step-3 wage card in src/report/sections.ts). (a) Add the decision lesson: 'Die Lohnerhöhung kommt mit und ohne neuen Preis. Für die Entscheidung A oder B zählen nur die +43 € pro Woche, die die 20 Cent bringen. Ob Sie danach so gut dastehen wie heute, ist eine zweite Frage.' (b) Replace the unqualified 'Der neue Preis trägt die Lohnerhöhung also' (report-price.txt:216) with a verdict that survives the caveat the report itself gives. When the margin left is smaller than the employer share on the rise (a guess, chip 'Eine Schätzung', e.g. about 20 %), say 'knapp: vor Arbeitgeberanteilen +1,40 €, mit etwa 20 % Arbeitgeberanteil rund −7 € pro Woche'. (c) Make the bar match the text (the bar says '+1 €', the text '1,40 €', report-price.txt:214/216). Why: misconceptions ('the 20 cents cover the wage rise'; 'a cost that comes either way decides between A and B'). Transfer: the same lesson as the sunk setup in the lunch demo. It worked when report-price.txt has the both-options sentence, no unqualified 'trägt … also', and the bar and the text show the same figure.

One word for the owner's middle guess, which is the misconception this rubric names: 'the expected scenario is what will happen'. src/engine/messages.de.ts:11 scn.expected 'Erwartet' and :408-409 'Erwartetes Ergebnis' label the bars and the card (report.txt:182, 189), and the result says 'Ihrem erwarteten Szenario' twice (report-result.txt:462). Yet the same number is 'Ihre wahrscheinliche Schätzung' everywhere else. The trio also has three names: 'schwacher Start … starker Start' (report.txt:173), 'langsamer Start, Ihre wahrscheinlichste Schätzung und ein starker Verlauf' (landing.txt:129) and 'Vorsichtig/Optimistisch'. Use 'Vorsichtig / Wahrscheinlich / Optimistisch' (+ 'Schätzung') on every surface. Do the same in EN ('Expected'), ES ('Esperado') and PL ('Oczekiwany'; also 'najbardziej prawdopodobny' vs 'prawdopodobny'). Add the three words to TERMS (src/i18n/terms.ts) so ui-terms checks them. It worked when no 'Erwartet/Expected/Esperado/Oczekiwany' remains on the landing, /try or report pages.

Close the loop after the test (src/report/sections.ts closing() renders analysis lessons only; resultBlock; the engine's result plain text). With input.result: (a) lead 'Was Sie gelernt haben' with what was measured, and drop 'Der Test selbst würde etwa 118 € im Minus enden' (report-result.txt:498), which contradicts the −184 € a screen above (:458). (b) Explain the miss guess by guess in her numbers instead of 'Das liegt nah an Ihrem erwarteten Szenario': '2 Gäste weniger pro Tag: −107 €; 21 % statt 30 % Wechsel: +41 €; zusammen −184 € statt −118 €'. (c) For the verdict 'Anpassen', make the first button 'Die Anpassung testen: 10,90 € eine Woche' (prefilled /try), not 'Test gemacht? Ergebnis eintragen' again (:533). Why: feedback that pins the error on a specific guess is what makes 'Ihre nächste Schätzung besser' (landing.txt:165), and the next small test is the transfer. It worked when report-result.txt shows the attribution line and a next-test button, and no conditional pre-test lesson.

Teach public rules as their own kind of number. Today 'Fakt' means both her till numbers ('Ein Fakt über Ihr Café' try-phone.txt:68, 'Wichtige Fakten und Ihr Plan' report.txt:127, 'Fakten über Ihr Café') and public rules ('Verwendete Berlin-Fakten' :148). Source (src/engine/types.ts:10) has no chip for a rule, and the take-home question asks only 'Von Ihnen, berechnet, geschätzt oder ausgedacht?' (report.txt:585, messages ai.rule). Rename the owner groups ('Ihre Zahlen und Ihr Plan', 'Ihre Zahl: aus Kasse oder Buchhaltung'). Give facts-card items a chip 'Öffentliche Regel · Stand …'. Show the VAT row in view as '7 % / 19 % (Regel) × Aufteilung 70/30 (angenommen) = 10,6 %'. Reconcile the 30 %: it is a rule in the card (report.txt:162) but 'geschätzt ist nur die Aufteilung' in the note. Say 'Die 30 % sind die anerkannte Pauschale; angenommen ist nur, dass sie zu Ihrem Angebot passt'. Add 'aus einer öffentlichen Regel mit Datum' to the take-home question in all four languages (ES 'Datos clave'/'Datos de Berlín' and PL 'fakty' have the same clash). Why: the Berlin facts are the loop-2 teaching gain, but the one transferable AI question leaves them out. It worked when one word is reserved for public rules and the take-home names five sources.

/try: ask the two guesses the report is built on (site/src/try.ts screens, review panel). Step 3 says 'Niemand weiß … drei Versionen', yet /try sets the range itself ('vorsichtig 3 … etwa 40 %', 'optimistisch 15 … 1,8-Fache', try-phone.txt screen 11) and the switching share (30 %). So the owner never states her own uncertainty, and the second cost the predict feedback names is never her number. After screen 10, add 'An einem schlechten / guten Tag: wie viele zusätzliche?' and 'Von 10 Mittagsstammgästen: wie viele würden zum Angebot wechseln?', each with a why and 'Weiß ich nicht'. Give screen 9 a why, as the only data screen without one ('Jeder Euro hier muss erst von zusätzlichen Gästen hereingeholt werden: daher die zweite Zahl in Schritt 4'). Relabel 'Anteil des Preises für Zutaten und Verpackung' as '… bei Ihren normalen Mittagsverkäufen (ohne Angebot)'. Right after she types 3,60 € per deal, it reads like a duplicate. Drop 'und was gehört dazu?' from screen 7, which has only a € field. It worked when try-phone.txt lists the two screens, screen 9 shows 'WARUM DAS WICHTIG IST', and the review panel holds fewer than 8 assumed values.

Self-check (src/report/sections.ts:781-801 renders it as a closed <details> under the print button; messages sc.wrong/sc.why.*). Show the first question open, and give each wrong option its own diagnostic line. Picking 'Aufhören' at 10 a day should get 'Die 180 € Startkosten sind schon ausgegeben; Aufhören holt sie nicht zurück. Ab 7 trägt sich jeder weitere Tag.', not only the restated rule. Smooth 'sc.why.tweak' ('6 pro Tag liegt zwischen 4 pro Tag und unter 7 pro Tag') to '6 pro Tag: mindestens 4, aber unter 7, also anpassen'. Why: retrieval only works if it happens, and feedback that names the sunk-cost error teaches more than repeating the rule. It worked when report-phone.png shows the first question without a tap, and a wrong answer to the sunk-cost item names the setup.
misconceptionsRisked: 'Erwartet is what will happen': the bars, the card and the result call the owner's likely guess 'Erwartet' / 'Ihr erwartetes Szenario' (report.txt:182, 189; report-result.txt:462), the same in EN/ES/PL.

'The 20 cents cover the wage rise': 'Der neue Preis trägt die Lohnerhöhung also … vor Arbeitgeberanteilen' on a +1,40 € margin (report-price.txt:216). With any realistic employer share the answer flips; the bar even rounds it to '+1 €'.
'The wage rise belongs in the A-vs-B decision': the report never says it comes with both options, while the step-1 tile shows +87 € against today's costs.
'A public rule is a Fakt like my till numbers': one word for both (try-phone.txt:68, report.txt:127/148), no chip for rules, and the take-home question omits them (report.txt:585).
'The 30 % drinks share is a guess' and 'it is a rule': both in one report (facts card report.txt:162 vs the VAT note in 'Alle 20 Zahlen').
'My range is 3 to 15': on /try What-IF sets 40 % and 1,8× of her one number, yet step 3 calls them her cautious and optimistic guesses.
'The test ended about −118 €': the closing lesson after a −184 € result (report-result.txt:498).
scaffoldingGaps: /try never asks the range or the switching share; they wait in a 12-field 'Angenommen, bitte prüfen' panel on the last screen (try-phone-11.png, 4,300 px).
Screen 9 groups five inputs and is the only data screen without 'Warum das wichtig ist'.
After a result, the miss is not traced to the guesses that caused it, and there is no scaffold for the next (tweak) test.
The self-check is folded, and wrong-answer feedback restates the rule instead of naming the error.
'36,57 € pro Tag zu decken' (report.txt:306) is never split into switching regulars, staff and promotion; only extra customers can be moved hands-on.
languageLoad: The German now carries the same load as the English. TERMS hold across landing, /try and report (Ausgedacht, Aufhören, Startkosten, Gewinnschwelle with '(auf Englisch: Break-even)' once), formats are right (9,90 €, 1.500 €), and it says 'Sie' throughout. Load left: 'Erwartet' beside 'wahrscheinliche Schätzung'; the 16-word label 'Zusätzliche Mittagsgäste pro Tag, mit denen das Angebot den Test hereinholt (mit Startkosten)', reused as the predict question, which on /try says '(mit Startkosten)' with 0 € setup; the calques 'Für jeden Tag nach dem Test reicht Ihre Schätzung (7)' and '6 pro Tag liegt zwischen 4 pro Tag und unter 7 pro Tag'. Spanish: 'Clientes más al mediodía cada día' reads oddly ('clientes extra'); the step status 'HECHO' collides with 'Hecho por una IA'; the caveat says 'suposición aproximada' while the chip says 'Una estimación'. Polish reads naturally but alternates 'najbardziej prawdopodobny'/'prawdopodobny szacunek' and uses 'fakty' for both kinds.
